about: Manga on the library bookcase, in the order written. Pages live at assets/manga/<id>/<chapter number>/<page>.webp with two-digit page numbers (01.webp, 02.webp, …), and the cover at assets/manga/<id>/cover.webp. Each chapter says how many pages it has. direction is "rtl" (read right to left, like Japanese manga) or "ltr"; status is "ongoing" (連載中) or "complete" (完結); shape is the shape of the pages and cover, width:height (2:3 if left out). The sample-manga entry is a 見本 (sample) for the preview.
